sql: SELECT recall_number, recalling_firm, firm_key, country, classification, status, initiation_date, report_date, substr(reason, 1, 220) AS reason, substr(product_description, 1, 160) AS product_description FROM fda.recalls WHERE firm_key IN ('actavis totowa', 'nerpharma', 'nerpharma s r l', 'actavis', 'areva') AND initiation_date >= '2020-01-01' AND lower(product_description) LIKE '%fludarabine%' ORDER BY initiation_date
